nodes.description: Private IERC20 state variable holding the token contract being timelocked.
Private address state variable for the beneficiary allowed to withdraw after release time.
Private uint256 state variable storing the timestamp at which token release becomes enabled.
Constructor of TokenTimelock; validates releaseTime_ against block.timestamp and initializes token, beneficiary and releaseTime.
Public view getter returning the held IERC20 token.
Public view getter returning the beneficiary address.
Public view getter returning the configured release timestamp.
Public virtual function that checks block.timestamp >= _releaseTime and transfers the full token balance to the beneficiary.
Constructor of the PredictrMKTG3TokenTimelock subclass forwarding arguments to the TokenTimelock base constructor.
block.timestamp used in the base constructor require(releaseTime_ > block.timestamp) comparison.
block.timestamp used in release() require(block.timestamp >= _releaseTime) gate.
External token transfer _token.safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount) that hands control to the token contract.
Constructor parameter token_ assigned to the _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ assigned to the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ compared to block.timestamp and assigned to _releaseTime.
Subclass constructor parameter token forwarded to the base constructor as token_.
Subclass constructor parameter beneficiary forwarded to the base constructor as beneficiary_.
Subclass constructor parameter releaseTime forwarded to the base constructor as releaseTime_.
Local uint256 inside release() holding _token.balanceOf(address(this)) that is transferred to the beneficiary.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is stored into the _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is stored into the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is stored into the _releaseTime state variable.
Subclass constructor parameter token is forwarded to the base constructor parameter token_.
Subclass constructor parameter beneficiary is forwarded to the base constructor parameter beneficiary_.
Subclass constructor parameter releaseTime is forwarded to the base constructor parameter releaseTime_.
Subclass constructor invokes the TokenTimelock base constructor via the inheritance modifier.
The base constructor require() depends on block.timestamp, creating a timestamp-dependency relation.
releaseTime_ is compared against block.timestamp, making constructor validity timestamp dependent.
_releaseTime is compared against block.timestamp in release(), a timestamp-dependency gate.
block.timestamp controls whether release() proceeds past its require() check.
_token is read inside release() to query balanceOf before transferring.
Local amount (the queried token balance) is passed into the safeTransfer call.
_token is the target contract of the external safeTransfer operation.
_beneficiary is the recipient argument of the external safeTransfer operation.
release() performs the external token transfer, an interaction that can re-enter or manipulate state after the external call.
The external safeTransfer call transfers control to the token contract, which can call back into release() before completion.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter token_ is only used to initialize state within the base constructor and carries no independent behavior.
Parameter beneficiary_ is only used to initialize state within the base constructor and carries no independent behavior.
Parameter releaseTime_ is only checked and stored inside the base constructor and carries no independent behavior.
Parameter token is a pure forwarder in the subclass constructor and should collapse into that constructor.
Parameter beneficiary is a pure forwarder in the subclass constructor and should collapse into that constructor.
Parameter releaseTime is a pure forwarder in the subclass constructor and should collapse into that constructor.
Local amount exists solely as the value argument of the external safeTransfer operation and should fold into it.
